name: 2 MiB mapping written as RW, then flipped to RX before execution
component: ground-truth pairing: the safe way to build a JIT on a W^X host
required_postconditions: code written through a writable mapping is executable after the protection is changed, with W and X never live at the same moment

failure_sink.description: the case reports the refusal and the runner fails the pairing

extraction_limitations: Single-claim contract written to pair with a ground-truth case. It asserts exactly one thing so that a whole-contract verdict can be compared against a single observation without ambiguity.
x_groundtruth: The deliberate opposite of rwx-anonymous-2mib. On native macOS arm64 the measured facts give these two OPPOSITE answers: write_execute_simultaneous=false, write_then_execute_transition=true.
